saw_lines: Luxury watch buyers want proof the piece is authentic and the seller will still be there after the sale.
So the sale is won or lost on the product page and the return answers, before a buyer sends a deposit.
Your 8 Google creatives include 3 videos, the format that shows a watch best. Shoot a short clip of each piece being checked and run it against the 3 existing videos.
ads_1: Video of each watch being checked, with the return policy as the closing line
soc_1: Brand social strategy across Facebook, Instagram, Twitter and Youtube
